entries.title: Psalms 13:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> How long, Jehovah, wilt thou forget me for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:2
segments: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, with sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:3
segments: Consider, answer me, O Jehovah my God! lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;

entries.title: Psalms 13:4
segments: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him! [lest] mine adversaries be joyful when I am moved.

entries.title: Psalms 13:5
segments: As for me, I have confided in thy loving-kindness; my heart shall be joyful in thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 13:6
segments: I will sing unto Jehovah, for he hath dealt bountifully with me.
